candidates.heading: Short title.
candidates.body_text: This Act may be called the Repealing and Amending Act, 2023.

candidates.heading: Repeal of certain enactments.
candidates.body_text: The enactments specified in the First Schedule and the Second Schedule are hereby repealed.

candidates.heading: Amendment of enactments.
candidates.body_text: The enactment specified in the Third Schedule is hereby amended to the extent and in the manner specified in the fourth column thereof.

candidates.heading: Savings.
